cases.case_label: De novo Alu just upstream of FGFR2 exon 9 (IIIc)
cases.mechanism_detail: De novo paternal Alu insertion just upstream of FGFR2 exon 9 (IIIc). Splicing of exon 9 was examined in patient fibroblasts and ectopic KGFR (IIIb, exon 8) isoform expression was observed, i.e. altered IIIb/IIIc splice choice; abstract does not specify which of the two Alu patients was tested.
cases.quote: Surprisingly, each patient harbors an Alu-element insertion of approximately 360 bp, in one case just upstream of exon 9 and in the other case within exon 9 itself.

cases.case_label: De novo Alu within FGFR2 exon 9 (IIIc)
cases.mechanism_detail: De novo paternal Alu insertion inside FGFR2 exon 9 (IIIc), proposed to disrupt IIIc splicing leading to ectopic KGFR (IIIb) expression; abstract does not state which Alu patient had RNA analysed.
cases.quote: Surprisingly, each patient harbors an Alu-element insertion of approximately 360 bp, in one case just upstream of exon 9 and in the other case within exon 9 itself.
